angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 986,642 km at 45.18 pc = 0.29 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 22.1315 +/- 0.0246 mas (same row, RUWE 1.03): 45.18 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.4182 +/- 0.0241 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 25463 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 986,642 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.251 +/- 0.0248 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 25463 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6353 +/- 85 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 25463 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 25463 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-25463.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.232, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 25463 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.018 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 25463 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.47276, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 25463 (pscomppars): age 2.3 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, HD 25463: projected rotation speed 10 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2005yCat.3244....0G)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
